scope: Document-only preview encoding and source/preview integrity validation. No artwork, producer manifest, planning entry, document, game, Git or deployment change.
loopPolicy: All review WebPs infinitely repeat (loop 0); action loop flags are preserved separately.
deduplicationPolicy: Only consecutive byte-identical visible RGBA source samples may be merged by encoding; their durations are summed exactly. Every original time interval retains its original visible pixels.

originalPreviewFindings.birthManifestNote: final-checks.json birth rows describe body-only 16 frames/1260 ms; planning-entries.json publishes complete scene 117 samples/4500 ms.
